## Type

- [ ] Feature or content change (feature/* -> develop)
- [ ] Release to production (develop -> main)

## Checklist

- [ ] Checked on the dev site (`/dev/`) on a phone and a laptop
- [ ] New photos are in `site/images/`, JPG, under 400 KB, one extension
- [ ] For a release: `VERSION` bumped and `CHANGELOG.md` has a section for it
